purpose: Attempt 01 was generated and rejected before source gate because it redrew a complete head and oversized the state objects. It remains provenance only; revision 2 must preserve the exact V9 face crop while retaining clear compact state objects.
identity_invariants: retain the locked V9 open oval eye silhouette, black fill, one large white oval highlight and one small white diamond sparkle per eye
retain the locked V9 eye-pair scale, spacing, baseline, tiny nose and monochrome ink weight
do not introduce a new eye shape, iris, pupil, eyelash, colour, face outline, ear, whisker or whole-face card
the state object is a clean separately extractable black-ink component in the 200x200 safe area and visibly anchors to the character pose
the state object changes the silhouette enough to survive the native 200x200 hold
use no detached flat UI/status glyph, text, label, menu icon, battery icon, waveform icon, emoji, generic dot, interchangeable sparkle or floating notification

state_object_semantic_brief.face_action: low composed brows with one restrained decision lift, same-side highlight attention and compact closed decision mouth
state_object_semantic_brief.silhouette_object: one prominent three-tab navigator visor/beret attached directly above and across the eyebrow line, with three rounded page-like tabs and a central clasp. It must look like a character-owned navigation cap, not a floating menu glyph, cursor or generic crown.
state_object_semantic_brief.choreography: visor tabs make one deliberate left-to-center-to-right settle while highlights scan and the face lands

state_object_semantic_brief.face_action: receptive low brows, centered attentive highlights, tiny closed acknowledgement mouth and calm cheeks
state_object_semantic_brief.silhouette_object: a large matched pair of rounded recording headset earcups hugging both outer eye-cheek edges plus one short curved pickup boom that reaches toward the mouth. This is an attached mascot headset object, not a detached microphone icon, waveform or generic wave. It must be visually unmistakable at 200x200 and extractable as left earcup, right earcup and boom components.
state_object_semantic_brief.choreography: headset arrives as a physical object, earcups pulse once outward after attention arrives, then the pickup boom settles while the face holds

state_object_semantic_brief.face_action: soft released low brows, settled lower highlights, compact closed restorative smile and softened lifted cheeks
state_object_semantic_brief.silhouette_object: one large rounded charging dock clasp anchored on the character's left outer cheek with a thick short tether curving into a small forehead energy-core jewel. The clasp and tether are physical character equipment, visibly connected to the face, never a detached battery, lightning, plug glyph or floating icon. The silhouette must read like the character is plugged into a charging dock at 200x200. Export clasp, tether and core as separate components.
state_object_semantic_brief.choreography: dock clasp arrives first, tether draws inward to the core, the core makes one restrained fill/settle movement as the recovery face releases, then all reverse exactly

panel_contract: Generate one unbordered, unlabeled left-to-right row of exactly three same-scale faces: menu_active, recording_active, charging_active. Each pose must contain one large integrated state object plus a distinct V9 face action. The panel is source provenance only; runtime may later use only registered components in a deterministic component sequence, never whole-face playback.
machine_preconditions_before_owner_revie: source gate proves locked-V9-only lineage, identity invariants, exactly the declared state-object components and native-200x200 silhouette delta
component export retains exact locked V9 identity components and source-derived face/state-object components only
browser and target PBM replay the same deterministic component plan at native 200x200
internal visual preflight evaluates unlabeled holds plus causal playback and rejects any state that is not unmistakable as navigation, recording or charging before an operator prompt
